keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «부는 어둠을 무서워한다(문제)» 와 «친구가 있으면 어둠도 덜 무섭다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Boo is afraid of the dark) and the lesson (the dark is not so scary with friends). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Boo, a little ghost, and the fireflies
Boo is afraid of the dark, and the wind blows his candle out.
Fireflies come and light up the night around Boo.

qs.q: Why does Boo start to shake?
opts: The wind blows his candle out, and it is dark.
evs: One night, the wind blows his candle out.
why: «One night, the wind blows his candle out.» 바람에 촛불이 꺼져서 깜깜해졌어요. 부는 어둠을 무서워해서 떨어요.
The wind blows his candle out, and it gets dark. Boo is afraid of the dark, so he shakes.

qs.q: "The fireflies dance around Boo and light up the night." What does "light up" mean?
qs.qko: «light up the night» 에서 «light up» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: Then he sees tiny lights outside the window.
why: «Then he sees tiny lights outside the window.» 반딧불이는 작은 불빛이에요. 그러니 «light up» 은 «환하게 밝히다» 라는 뜻이에요.
Boo sees tiny lights, and they are fireflies. So "light up" means make it bright.

qs.q: Why is the dark not so scary for Boo now?
qs.qko: 이제 부에게 어둠이 왜 덜 무서운가요?
opts: Firefly friends dance around him and make the night bright.
He finds a new candle in the attic.
evs: The fireflies dance around Boo and light up the night.
The dark is not so scary with friends.
Ghosts love the night, but Boo is afraid of the dark!
One night, the wind blows his candle out.
why: 반딧불이들이 부 주위에서 춤추며 밤을 밝혀 주고(«The fireflies dance around Boo and light up the night.»), 친구가 있으면 어둠이 덜 무서워요(«The dark is not so scary with friends.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The fireflies dance around Boo and light up the night, and the dark is not so scary with friends. You need both sentences.

ends: Boo and the fireflies play hide-and-seek every night.
Boo helps a little girl who is afraid of the dark.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)
write.src: “Let’s <u>watch the fireflies</u> before <u>we go to sleep</u>.”

img.cover: In a dark, cozy attic at night, a small round white ghost with big black eyes, rosy cheeks and a wavy tail floats in the middle and smiles as dozens of glowing yellow fireflies dance around him and light up the room.

scenes.1: In a dark attic at night, a small round white ghost with big black eyes, rosy cheeks and a wavy tail shivers next to a candle that has just blown out with a thin curl of smoke, and he peeks at tiny glowing lights outside the round window.
scenes.2: Outside an old house under a starry sky, a small round white ghost with big black eyes, rosy cheeks and a wavy tail floats by the open attic window and smiles as a swirl of glowing fireflies dances around him and lights up the night.
